population.text: The safety analysis set included all randomized patients who received at least 1 dose of intranasal study medication or 1 dose of oral AD medication during the double-blind treatment phase.

span.text: The safety analysis set included all randomized patients who received at least 1 dose of intranasal study medication or 1 dose of oral AD medication during the double-blind treatment phase.

notes: Counts are patients with 1 or more TEAEs during the double-blind phase, not numbers of episodes. Table 4 supplies safety denominators. Two randomized arms; esketamine 56 mg and 84 mg were flexible doses within one arm. Other adverse-event subsets in Table 4 are TEAEs possibly related to intranasal drug (117 [92.9%] versus 55 [43.7%]), treatment-emergent serious adverse events (3 [2.4%] in each arm), and TEAEs leading to discontinuation of intranasal study medication (7 [5.6%] versus 2 [1.6%]); these are not the overall adverse-event count. Values are in esketamine versus placebo order.
